(1) The provisions of this Act shall not apply to a
sale, purchase or transfer of unlisted securities which have
been exempted in terms of section 80.
(2) The rules relating to unlisted securities applicable to
this  trading  platform  made  by  the  Commission  or  the
recognised market operator under this Part shall prevail over
any other rules relating to unlisted securities.
